fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: Sends a barbed polyp after the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage and leaving it [Marked] for 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Corner the Quarry
fusions.desc: Looses 3 polyps spread apart, each dealing 24 damage. When one hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Held in the Shallows
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds. A line of polyps fights beside you for 6 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Wounded Prey
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 5% at all times.
